[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Bossam: Boiled pork belly wrapped in lettuce leaves with sauce and kimchi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Tteokbokki: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet and spicy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Sundubu jjigae: A soft tofu stew made with seafood and a spicy sauce.
